mainEntity.name: Copyfy or SellerCenter: which one is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: AI product research, store analysis, pages and going live. SellerCenter works if you just want to track the sales of a few Shopify stores for free. To launch and run a store, Copyfy comes out on top; for a free peek, SellerCenter gets you by.

On the sticker price, yes (gratuit against 49€/month). On the real cost of your stack, no: SellerCenter only covers Shopify sales tracking, so you have to add other subscriptions to launch a store, while Copyfy does the whole job for 49€/month with a 5-day trial and no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which one has the better product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy, without hesitation. Its AI targets winning products directly and analyzes competitor stores in depth, where SellerCenter is limited to reading the best-sellers of Shopify stores. To get quickly to a product worth launching, Copyfy's approach is more direct.

Yes. Copyfy covers everything SellerCenter offers for free (spotting stores and products that sell), adding AI product research, page generation, image imports and a far deeper competitive analysis. Migrating to Copyfy is simple the moment you want to get serious.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. SellerCenter has a free plan limited to 5 stores. Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial, no credit card. The simplest is to test Copyfy for free to see if the suite covers your need.
